s: The Kokiri are a recurring race of humans in The Legend of Zelda series, their debut being in Ocarina of Time. Young in both mind and body, the Kokiri are Hylian children that have been granted everlasting youth by the Great Deku Tree, whom they revere as their creator and protector.

t: Kokiri | Zeldapedia | Fandom
s: The Kokiri (コキリ, Kokiri?) also known as Forest Folk, Forest Spirits, Fairy Folk, Kokiri Tribe, Forest Fairies, and Children of the Forest are a recurring race from the Legend of Zelda series. They are a diminutive and secretive race of forest spirits who take on the appearance of Hylian children and are native to Kokiri Forest and the Lost Woods.
